business.name: Good Intentions
business.tagline: Secondhand clothes, picked with good intentions.
business.description: Sage finds one-of-one secondhand pieces, builds collections around music and mood, and helps people put together outfits that actually feel like them.

brand.visualDirection: A dark plum editorial foundation with warm cream type, saturated pink-orange-purple gradients, glowing circular motifs, and enough restraint for each collection to introduce its own mood.

commerce.localPickup: Not offered for normal website orders. Prearranged handoff may happen at in-person events.
commerce.inventoryModel: Most clothing is assumed to be one-of-one until Sage confirms otherwise.
commerce.developmentNotice: The secure checkout flow is being connected now. Products will stay unavailable until their photos, measurements, policies, shipping, and inventory checks are complete.

collections.name: Shakira Collection
collections.description: Metallic details, statement belts, low-rise energy, and pieces made for going out.

collections.name: A Midsummer Night's Dream
collections.description: Lace, soft layers, florals, and clothes that look like they belong in a fairy-lit backyard.

collections.name: Zara Larsson Collection
collections.description: Bright colors, playful shapes, and glossy 2000s pop-girl energy.

collections.name: Whimsigoth Collection
collections.description: Celestial prints, flowing layers, velvet, and a little witchy drama.

styleBundles.summary: Tell Sage what you wear, what you wish you wore, and what you never want to see. She will put together a secondhand bundle around you.
process: Send Sage your sizes, measurements, budget, inspiration, favorite colors, and anything you absolutely do not want.
She will talk it through with you, confirm the price and timing, and make sure she understands the vibe.
Sage finds and styles the pieces, checking in whenever a choice needs your input.
Your bundle ships within the U.S. or can be handed off at an event if arranged ahead of time.

personalStyling.summary: There is no one-size-fits-all styling package. Message Sage and talk through what you need, whether that is one outfit, a new direction, or help making your closet feel more like you.

donations.summary: Send Sage clear photos first. She will let you know what she can use before anything is shipped or brought to an event.
donations.compensation: Donors do not normally receive payment, credit, or another benefit.

events.summary: You can usually find Good Intentions at vintage markets, pop-ups, and community events around New York and nearby.

policies.shipping: Website orders will ship within the United States. Final shipping rates and handling times will be posted before checkout opens.
policies.returns: The return and exchange policy is still being finalized and will be posted clearly before the first website sale.
policies.oneOfOne: Most pieces are one-of-one. An item is not held until payment is complete.
policies.condition: These are secondhand clothes, so some wear is normal. Any known flaw will be photographed and written into the listing.
policies.customServices: Style bundles and personal styling start with a direct conversation. Sage will confirm the price, timing, and what is included before payment.
policies.donations: Please send photos before shipping or bringing anything. Sage will confirm what she can accept and how to hand it off.
